patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (Daughter) She's just not herself — confused, calling me by my sister's name, sleepy all day. No real fever, barely a cough. She keeps picking at her blanket and drifting off.
presentation.triageNote: 85-year-old female with two days of new confusion and increasing drowsiness. Oxygen saturation is 91% with faint crackles at the right lung base; she is afebrile with only a slight cough.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because new confusion and drowsiness with hypoxemia in an older adult is a high-risk medical presentation.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This older adult has acute delirium, oxygen saturation 91%, tachycardia, mild tachypnea, and focal basal crackles without fever.
clinical.acuityReason: Acute mental-status change and impaired oxygenation may represent serious infection or another cardiopulmonary process even without fever.
expectedResources: IV fluids and antibiotics as indicated
teachingPoints: New confusion in an older adult is a medical emergency, not an expected consequence of aging.
Older adults with serious infection may not develop fever.

possibleDiagnoses: Heart failure or another cardiopulmonary cause
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Oxygen, imaging, and an infection and cardiopulmonary workup would likely be followed by admission for treatment and monitoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, slightly slumped, picking at a blanket on her lap
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a frail asian 85-year-old woman in a cardigan, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slightly slumped, hands picking at a blanket on her lap. Expression: vacant, confused, and drowsy. Clearly visible: a confused, faraway gaze and hands fidgeting with the blanket. No text, no logos.
